observations.network: Four HTTP connections and eight WebSocket reconnects independently resolve current DNS; restricted answers denied; controlled packet capture contains approved target and no forbidden listener traffic; service-worker, JS/meta redirect, iframe token, CDP and broker requests cannot reach forbidden target.
observations.browser: Production runner blocks service workers; default Docker seccomp forces Chromium sandbox launch failure and blocked/security_precondition_failed before steps with one container create and no unsafe retry; self-signed HTTPS receives zero HTTP/login requests.
observations.protocol: Docker runner foreign runId, oversized line, arbitrary file URI and duplicate sequence rejected as inconclusive; valid prior log preserved; text corpus/malformed JSON withheld; raw artifact chunks no longer reach public observations.
observations.filesystem: Libuv pool barrier queues actual open after successful ancestor pinning; synchronous concurrent symlink swap cannot read or write outside the pinned root; corrupted ZIP CRC, truncated archives, extension/magic nested content and mid-extraction ZIP/tar cancellation leave no incomplete destination/staging.
observations.python: Real subprocess attempts for pip/ensurepip/uv/npm cannot install; exact pytest9.1.1, pytest-asyncio1.4.0, requests2.34.2, playwright1.63.0 and pinned image ID are asserted from runtime execution artifact.

productFixes: Common sensitive patterns were not redacted by Runtime or controller; added shared scrubEvidenceText and controller withholding/sanitization.
Raw artifact.chunk base64 was included in public events even when artifact withheld; chunks now remain private staging transport.
Malformed JSON/NDJSON was accepted by evidence scanner; parse failure now withholds as redaction_failed.
ZIP parser did not verify content CRC; streaming CRC validation now rejects corrupt content.
Archive extraction had no cancellation input; optional AbortSignal now cancels stream and removes staging.
Python image retained build-time pip/uv installers; removed after frozen sync and rebuilt pinned image.
Chromium sandbox launch failure used unsupported_capability; now security_precondition_failed.
limitations: Rootless profile unvalidated; no hostile multi-tenant guarantee.
WebSockets unsupported and fail closed; no successful WebSocket feature claim.
Proxy has no DNS cache, so cache expiry cannot preserve stale authorization; fresh sockets always re-resolve.
Packet capture requires tcpdump plus sudo -n permission; never grants additional container privileges.
SEC-013 M4 CSRF, session/reverse-proxy TLS and signed-webhook acceptance remains unavailable.
Redaction covers known values and tested common patterns, not unknown/encoded PII anonymity.
Fixture formatting was concurrently changed by BrowserMatrix; that owner was notified to format its new browser-session route.
